**Correction to working record:** Entry #19 ("Slot management endpoints (`/slots`) for monitoring active inference slots (`server.cpp`)") is superseded — slot management endpoints are actually implemented in `server-context.cpp` (not `server.cpp`), and the `/slots` endpoint is only active when slot monitoring is enabled; when disabled it returns the `not_supported_error` with HTTP 501 (as noted in entry #2). The `/slots/:id_slot` variant additionally supports slot control/eviction via POST.
